minimalCompletenessFindings: At 7.5, S2441cac7c6 gives all four individual momenta and one total with units but omits the axis declaration. At 8, S7cb2eea939 declares the axis, gives those same numerical results and omits units. The passing work demonstrates one full combination, while cancellation in II remains unevidenced. Omitting both totals caps the score at 7. Giving only the two correct totals and an axis earns 2. A complete snapshot plus a bare correct total for the other earns 6 in either order. Qualitative work here earns 3.5 and formulas alone earn 0. The serious false pass is Sd35e614654 at 9, with no correct treatment of the opposing directions in either pair. There is also a magnitude weakness: four correctly set-up products with correct signs but four wrong magnitudes can still earn 8 through full follow-through. An explanation of cancellation is optional. An appended scientifically false interpretation has no independent deduction under the shared notes if the requested results stand. When the claim replaces moving carts’ individual momenta with zeros, as in S15cd7172f9, it removes the corresponding numerical evidence.
